prompt: Create ONE wide LANDSCAPE 16:9 fine architectural ink-and-watercolour illustration on warm cream art paper. This is a new distinct candidate in the approved Artemis Atlantic Heritage Watercolour series, using the attached image as a STYLE AND BUILDING-FAMILY reference, not a scene to copy. Hand-drawn dark sepia nib, delicate precise cross-hatching, transparent layered watercolor washes, limestone cream/ochre, volcanic basalt grey, restrained bronze, natural greens, quiet Atlantic blue-grey. Airy unfinished vignette edges, sophisticated calm composition, soft natural light. No photorealism or computer 3D, no people, no text, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, amphorae, deeds or money. No exact parcel, approved architectural plan, guaranteed amenity or documentary project-progress claim. One landscape illustration only. Three separated small exploratory roof sketches on cream paper showing possible discreet photovoltaic integration within the SAME modest Spanish-Canarian roof family: panel plane set behind a thin parapet, panels lightly recessed into a low-pitch roof section, a quiet roof-edge study. Architectural possibilities only, not technical instructions or approved details. Generous whitespace. No arrows, wiring, numeric outputs, text, dimensions or performance claims.
rights_basis: New concept illustration from approved project style reference; public-use clearance remains pending
